description: Every alert_type the agent can send to the GRID (AlertMapper). Checked from both sides: the agent test (AlertTypeContractTests) recomputes this list from the code and requires equality; the GRID test (test_alert_modules.py) requires each entry to map to a module, never UNKNOWN.
notes: SentinelCanary* come from CanaryAlertType; Entropy* from the entropy rules (EntropyExtensionWhitelist alerts are Suppressed and never forwarded, listed because the rule exists); ExfilWatch* from the IExfilDetectionRule implementations; UsbGuard is fixed.
IndicatorRemoval* is not listed: AlertMapper.FromIndicatorRemovalEvent has no caller, the agent cannot send it. If it ever does, the GRID maps it to UNKNOWN explicitly.
